audit.summary: Lemma 3.2's general component-quotient assertion is false. A diamond quotient by discrete Z is connected although its source components have multiple orbits. Explicit dependency through Proposition 3.12 and Proposition 6.11 enters Theorem 6.1. Actual shtuka statements and the main theorem are not refuted.
